items.q: What does an inspector actually ask an audit agent?
items.a: Not whether it was right, but **how it arrived at the decision**—"the model said so" won't cut it.
The agent may **draft unreviewed rows** but must **never overwrite** what a human already reviewed.
So a rerun years later can be **diffed step by step** to show you were right, not lucky.
Treat it as **identity**: document ID, version, **content hash** and source—not a filename string.

items.q: What did auditing the gold set reveal?
items.a: At 97%, **4 of 9 misses** were wrong labels and **12 passes** were stale—the score hid both.

items.q: How should agents escalate to humans?
items.a: Only on **exceptions**, with the discrepancy spelled out—**easy to verify, not easy to approve**.
